race.comment: MISNEACH (5) returns with the strongest upside, having run in the Listed ANZAC Day Stakes after a solid fourth at Pakenham, beaten by less than three lengths. He won a Cranbourne trial, gets Damian Lane, and wears blinkers for the first time, making him a strong contender for this maiden. SILKY SETH (2) continued the consistent start to his career at Sale last start where he was beaten by under two lengths after early tightening. His wide barrier and quick turnaround are concerns, but his distance record keeps him competitive. PLATINUM RUSH (8) has been competitive all campaign, finishing just over a length behind at Echuca and drawing barrier 1 with a 1.5kg claim, although her past attempts at this distance raise doubts. EMANATING (7) has won a trial since her last start and the blinkers go on now. Keep safe.
